description:
Count businesses of a kind in a place in Spain, per 10,000 residents and per km², from OpenStreetMap.

    Use it to size competition and supply: how many gyms, cafés or dentists an area has,
    how that compares with the province, region and Spain, which brands dominate, and
    which districts or tracts are over- or under-served (rank sub-areas by
    per_10k_residents). Counts are lower bounds because OpenStreetMap is mapped by
    volunteers; where INE's company directory covers the same activity, the result says
    how complete the map looks in that region. Returns counts and brands only, never
    lists of individual premises.

category.description: What to count. A category: restaurant, fast_food, cafe, bar, ice_cream, nightclub, supermarket, convenience, bakery, butcher, greengrocer, drinks_tobacco, clothes, pharmacy, optician, beauty_shop, jewellery, florist, pet_shop, electronics, home, books_leisure, variety_store, hairdresser, beauty_salon, laundry, dentist, doctor, physiotherapy, hospital, veterinary, gym, sports_centre, dance_studio, cinema_theatre, private_school, childcare, school, hotel, guest_house, camp_site, estate_agent, lawyer, accountant, insurance, travel_agency, coworking, bank, fuel, car_repair, car_dealer, car_wash. Plain words work too ('gyms', 'peluquerías'). Or a sector: food_drink, food_retail, retail, personal_services, health, leisure, education, accommodation, professional, finance, motoring. Or OpenStreetMap tags: 'shop=bakery' or 'amenity=bar,amenity=pub'. Leave empty for all businesses, broken down by category.
category.title: Category

place.description: Place name or INE code: municipality ('Valladolid' or '47186'), province ('41'; a bare name like 'Sevilla' means the city), autonomous community ('Cataluña' or 'CA09'), district ('4718603') or census tract ('4718603012'). 'Name, Province' picks between same-named towns.
place.title: Place

sub_areas.description: For a municipality, also count by 'district' or census 'tract'. Default 'none'.
sub_areas.title: Sub Areas
